eventMetadata.context_description: Purdue Boilermakers' commanding size advantage, spearheaded by two-time All-American center Zach Edey (25.1 PPG, 12.2 RPG), anchors the 75.5% implied probability against Miami Hurricanes in this Sweet 16 clash, as Miami's smaller frontcourt has yielded 68 points per game to elite bigs this tournament. Purdue enters with momentum from decisive wins over Utah State and Grambling State, boasting top-ranked offensive efficiency despite last year's first-round exit fueling redemption. No major injuries reported on official updates—Edey's fully cleared, Miami's Nijel Pack probable—while Purdue's rest edge and 20-3 road/neutral record bolster trader consensus. Miami's gritty upsets over Detroit Mercy and VCU highlight upset potential, but head-to-head history favors Purdue's physicality.
